Docs.summary: The optional customer VM or VMSS identity used by the Neuron agent. Omission and explicit None are accepted on create. SystemAssigned requires nonzero principalId and tenantId; UserAssigned requires exactly one non-null dictionary entry with nonzero principalId and clientId and no top-level IDs. The declared combined identity kind is rejected. Caller-supplied identifiers are returned on read; service-side verification of their association with the target remains required. Omission on update preserves the stored identity; a supplied identity must be unchanged. Explicit None cannot clear an existing identity. Changing identity requires deleting and recreating the protected resource.
